description: accim is a Python package developed by Sánchez-García and collaborators to change fixed temperature-setpoint building models into adaptive-comfort-controlled EnergyPlus models. It adds the Adaptive Comfort Control Implementation Script to IDF files and exposes choices for comfort standards, operating modes, ventilation limits, seasons and output reporting. The repository also documents parametric simulation, weather-file handling and result analysis through example notebooks. Coverage is the user's building and climate file, with reporting selectable from simulation timesteps through hourly and longer intervals; no fixed observed building stock is supplied by this record. Public source is free under GPL-3.0. The README requires Python 3.9 or newer and lists supported EnergyPlus releases from 9.1 to 25.1. Caveats include the need to choose appropriate comfort assumptions and to check generated models when results or errors differ from expectations. The tool supports comparisons of adaptive setpoints, comfort and energy demand, extending the catalogue's EnergyPlus model (model-energyplus). Published describing papers are linked, but their performance claims were not independently tested here.
